source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Agriculture Practice
blurb: Practice sample traceability, research-resource allocation, and variety-trial analysis.

rounds.title: Agricultural Field Assistant: Resolve an Uncertain Sample Label
rounds.focus: Preserve sample identity uncertainty so a plausible correction cannot corrupt a crop trial.

rounds.title: Agricultural Trial Coordinator: Reconcile a Research Water Budget
rounds.focus: Resolve a constrained trial budget while preserving protocol minima and a transparent record of deviations.

rounds.title: Senior Agricultural Scientist: Challenge a Variety Adoption Claim
rounds.focus: Separate a one-plot observed advantage from a causal adoption claim and design a stronger agricultural comparison.
